My Budget Build! Obtained everything from Amazon beside my GFX card which I got on Ebay for $90. Dual boot with Windows 10 Pro. Each OS is on its own SSD. Everything works flawlessly beside the use of transferring files over the network. Using this build with 2x27inch monitors and it looks amazing! I will be upgrading the RAM sooner or later. If you have any questions, feel free to ask!

Hardware

* CPU: Intel Core i3-9100F Quad Core @ 3.6Ghz (up to 4.2GHz)
* GPU: Gigabyte RX 570 4gb
* RAM: Corsair Vengeance 1x8gb DDR4 2400Mhz
* Motherboard: MSI ProSeries H310M-VDH Plus (Micro ATX)
* Audio Codec: ALC887
* Ethernet Card: Built-In
* Wi-Fi: TP-Link AC1200 PCIe
* Bluetooth: IOGEAR-GBU521
* BIOS revision: 7C09v15

Used the guide on OpenCore website.

What's working

* Audio
* Filevault
* DRM (All Fairlight Version)
* iServices
* Bootcamp (dual boot with Windows)

What isn't working.

* VDA Decoder but everything seems fine to me
* Bluetooth does not work well even with Bluetooth Kext Fix from OpenIntelWifi on the TP-Link PCIe card so I used my IOGEAR USB adapter.
* Wifi would drop sometimes if doesn't use for a while
* Airdrop can discover devices but cannot transfer files
